{{for|the car|Renault Espace}}

In [[computational complexity theory]], the [[complexity class]] '''ESPACE''' is the set of [[decision problem]]s that can be solved by a [[deterministic Turing machine]] in space 2<sup>[[Big O notation|O]](n)</sup>.

See also '''[[EXPSPACE]]'''.
